title: How to Choose the Right Research Topic
shortDescription: A practical framework for selecting a research topic that matters.
author: Dr. Momena Begum

content.heading: Start with Relevance
content.text: A strong topic addresses a real clinical or academic gap. Review recent literature to confirm the question hasn't already been conclusively answered.

content.heading: Assess Feasibility
content.text: Consider your access to data, time, budget, and ethical clearance requirements before committing to a topic.

content.heading: Aim for Originality
content.text: Even a well-studied area can yield a novel contribution through a new population, method, or angle.

title: 5 Common Mistakes in Manuscript Writing
shortDescription: Avoid these pitfalls that lead to manuscript rejection.
author: Dr. Momena Begum

content.heading: Weak Introduction Framing
content.text: Reviewers form early impressions from the introduction — vague problem statements are a common rejection trigger.

content.heading: Overloaded Results Sections
content.text: Avoid duplicating data across text, tables, and figures; each should serve a distinct purpose.

content.heading: Ignoring Journal Guidelines
content.text: Formatting non-compliance is one of the most preventable reasons for desk rejection.

title: Understanding P-Values: A Practical Guide
shortDescription: Demystifying one of the most misunderstood statistical concepts.
author: Research Academy Team

content.heading: What a P-Value Actually Means
content.text: A p-value indicates the probability of observing your data (or more extreme) if the null hypothesis were true — not the probability the hypothesis is correct.

content.heading: Reporting Correctly
content.text: Always report exact p-values alongside effect sizes and confidence intervals rather than only 'p < 0.05'.

title: AI Tools Every Researcher Should Know in 2026
shortDescription: A curated list of AI tools accelerating modern research.
author: Research Academy Team

content.heading: Literature Screening
content.text: AI-assisted screening tools can cut systematic review title/abstract screening time significantly while maintaining reviewer oversight.

content.heading: Responsible Use
content.text: AI tools should assist, not replace, critical appraisal — always verify AI-generated summaries against source material.

title: Navigating the IRB Approval Process
shortDescription: A step-by-step guide to getting ethical clearance for your study.
author: Dr. Momena Begum

content.heading: Prepare Your Documents Early
content.text: Consent forms, data management plans, and risk assessments should be drafted well before submission deadlines.

content.heading: Anticipate Committee Questions
content.text: Common IRB queries relate to vulnerable populations, data storage, and withdrawal procedures — address these proactively.
